$comment: Exam form(s). v1 ships one form; schema is multi-form-ready. Built at S6 per .claude/skills/exam-publish (step 1) by exam-examiner, 2026-08-18, on the S5 round-2 bank revision (eval commit 10ccb89; author rework 168ae1f). Selection method (methodology/02 #method: priority is COMPUTED convergence, sources>=2; /exam-publish step 1): seat priority:high concepts first, then fill to the manifest's per-domain format mix using measured S5 quality (eval/judge-scores.json) and blueprint task-statement coverage; reserves are substitutes, not rejects. Arithmetic verified against manifest: 50 items = d1 12 (10 SC + 2 MR) + d2 15 (12+3) + d3 17 (14+3) + d4 6 (5+1); 41 SC + 9 MR + 0 scenario_matching (CLF-C02 has no scenario_matching item type - see manifest.format_coverage); 32 of 34 high-priority concepts seated + 18 normal fills; 18 reserve-only concepts. HAND-ADJUSTMENTS (documented per skill): (1) d1 MR mix allows 2 MR seats against 3 MR bank items - high 1.09 (CAF) seated, and 1.05 (six Well-Architected pillars) seated over 1.12 (on-premises hidden costs) on COVERAGE not score: reserving 1.05 would leave blueprint task 1.2 with a single seat, while 1.12's cost concept is adjacent to seated 1.11 (CAPEX->OPEX) and 1.16 (economies of scale). Explicit cost of that trade: 1.05 carries dimension-5 = 3 (recall-shaped list) and is in the Gate 2 sample. (2) d3 has 4 high-priority MR concepts for 3 MR seats - 3.14 (storage models) reserved as the lowest-scoring d3 item (26; dim2 = 3, dim4 = 4) and because its concept is adjacent to seated 3.15 (S3 storage classes); 3.04, 3.11, 3.19 seated. (3) d4 has 2 high-priority MR concepts for 1 MR seat - 4.06 (five support tiers) seated over 4.03 (which data movements carry charges) because the support cluster would otherwise carry no plan-comparison item, while 4.03's cost mechanics sit beside seated 4.02 (consolidated billing) and 4.04 (cost tools); 4.03 is the first-line substitute. (4) Normal-priority fills chosen for blueprint-task coverage and measured quality: d1 1.02/1.06/1.08/1.10/1.14/1.15/1.16 (1.10 is the round-1 bounce survivor, seated so the Gate 2 deep-read confirms the fix on a form item); d2 2.03 (shared controls, 30/30), 2.08 (AWS Artifact), 2.09 (compliance varies by geography), 2.20 (Marketplace security products), 2.21 (Trusted Advisor, 30/30); d3 3.12 (security groups vs network ACLs, dim5 = 5), 3.16 (AWS Backup - restores the storage cluster to 2 seats after 3.14 was reserved), 3.20 (business applications - keeps blueprint task 3.8 represented alongside 3.19); d4 4.05 (cost allocation tags - keeps the billing cluster at its proportional 3 seats). (5) Quality-driven reserves among normals: 1.01 (value proposition, generic - covered by seated 1.03 benefits discrimination and 1.16), 1.04 (dim1 = 4 and the bank's only medium-confidence blind answer; Well-Architected coverage retained via 1.05 + 1.06), 1.07 (lowest d1 total 26, dim2 = 3 and dim5 = 3), 2.01 (dim5 = 3 'of the cloud / in the cloud' recall; shared-responsibility coverage retained via 2.02/2.03/2.04), 2.05 (dim5 = 3), 2.14 (root-only actions - overlaps seated 2.13 root-user cluster), 2.17 (external identity - adjacent to seated 2.16 authentication capability), 2.19 (dim5 = 3 measured word-match, examiner flagged it for a later rewrite wave), 3.02 (deployment models - partially exercised by seated 3.01 and 3.13), 3.10 (DMS/SCT), 3.21/3.22/3.23 (task 3.8 long tail behind seated 3.19/3.20), 4.08 (dim4 = 4; help destinations adjacent to seated 4.07 partner/Professional Services channels). (6) Flagged items ON the form (Gate 2 deep-reads them there): 1.05, 1.09, 2.04, 2.06, 3.11 (dimension-5 or dimension-2 3s whose concepts are high-priority or coverage-load-bearing), 1.10 (bounce survivor), 4.05 (dim1 = 4, referred by name in the eval). Same-domain, same-format reserves exist as substitutes for every one of them if the Gate 2 deep read rejects any.
